class.name: RandomNumberGenerator
class.brief_description: Provides methods for generating pseudo-random numbers.

method.name: fork
method.description: Cgame extension: creates a new, independent [RandomNumberGenerator] using a deterministic seed derived from this generator's [member seed] and the signed 64-bit [param stream_id]. Repeating the call with the same original seed and stream ID returns a new generator producing the same sequence. Different stream identifiers yield differently mixed seeds. Neither this method nor [method get_substream_seed] consumes random values or changes the parent's [member state], so generation is unaffected by stream creation order or by previous draws on the parent. This enables independent procedural terrain, vegetation, animation, effects, and parallel generation tasks. It does not guarantee non-overlapping subsequences of PCG and is not cryptographically secure. The 32-bit-word seed mixing is deterministic across Cgame platforms but may change only with an explicitly documented seed-mixer version change.

method.name: get_substream_seed
method.description: Cgame extension: returns the deterministic 64-bit PCG seed assigned to [method fork] for this [param stream_id]. Uses all 64 bits of [member seed] and [param stream_id], independent of the current [member state]. No random values are consumed. The seed is exposed as a signed integer, with the same 64-bit bit pattern used by [method set_seed]; store that pattern unchanged to reproduce the stream. This method does not modify the parent.

method.name: rand_color_hsv
method.description: Returns a random color whose hue, saturation, value and alpha are each drawn uniformly from the given ranges (similar to Unity's [code]Random.ColorHSV[/code]). The defaults produce any fully opaque color.

method.name: rand_in_circle
method.description: Returns a point uniformly distributed over the disk of the given [param radius] centered at the origin (like Unity's [code]Random.insideUnitCircle[/code]). The distribution is uniform in area, so points do not cluster in the center.

method.name: rand_in_sphere
method.description: Returns a point uniformly distributed inside the ball of the given [param radius] centered at the origin (like Unity's [code]Random.insideUnitSphere[/code]).

method.name: rand_on_circle
method.description: Returns a point uniformly distributed on the circle of the given [param radius] centered at the origin (like Unity's [code]Random.onUnitCircle[/code]).

method.name: rand_on_sphere
method.description: Returns a point uniformly distributed on the surface of the sphere of the given [param radius] centered at the origin (like Unity's [code]Random.onUnitSphere[/code]). Multiply a unit result to get a random direction.

method.name: rand_rotation
method.description: Returns a uniformly distributed random orientation as a unit [Quaternion] (like Unity's [code]Random.rotationUniform[/code]). Every orientation is equally likely, which is not true of picking three random Euler angles.

method.name: rand_weighted
randf
method.description: Returns a pseudo-random float between [code]0.0[/code] and [code]1.0[/code] (inclusive).

method.name: randf_range
method.description: Returns a pseudo-random float between [param from] and [param to] (inclusive).

method.name: randfn
method.description: Returns a [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Normal_distribution]normally-distributed[/url], pseudo-random floating-point number from the specified [param mean] and a standard [param deviation]. This is also known as a Gaussian distribution. [b]Note:[/b] This method uses the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Box%E2%80%93Muller_transform]Box-Muller transform[/url] algorithm.

method.name: randi
method.description: Returns a pseudo-random 32-bit unsigned integer between [code]0[/code] and [code]4294967295[/code] (inclusive).

method.name: randi_range
method.description: Returns a pseudo-random 32-bit signed integer between [param from] and [param to] (inclusive).

method.name: randomize
method.description: Sets up a time-based seed for this [RandomNumberGenerator] instance. Unlike the [@GlobalScope] random number generation functions, different [RandomNumberGenerator] instances can use different seeds.

members.member: Initializes the random number generator state based on the given seed value. A given seed will give a reproducible sequence of pseudo-random numbers. [b]Note:[/b] The RNG does not have an avalanche effect, and can output similar random streams given similar seeds. Consider using a hash function to improve your seed quality if they're sourced externally. [b]Note:[/b] The default value of this property is pseudo-random, and changes when calling [method randomize]. The [code]0[/code] value documented here is a placeholder, and not the actual default seed. [b]Note:[/b] Setting this property produces a side effect of changing the internal [member state], so make sure to initialize the seed [i]before[/i] modifying the [member state]: [codeblock] var rng = RandomNumberGenerator.new() rng.seed = hash("Godot") rng.state = 100 # Restore to some previously saved state. [/codeblock]

The current state of the random number generator. Save and restore this property to restore the generator to a previous state: [codeblock] var rng = RandomNumberGenerator.new() print(rng.randf()) var saved_state = rng.state # Store current state. print(rng.randf()) # Advance internal state. rng.state = saved_state # Restore the state. print(rng.randf()) # Prints the same value as previously. [/codeblock] [b]Note:[/b] Do not set state to arbitrary values, since the random number generator requires the state to have certain qualities to behave properly. It should only be set to values that came from the state property itself. To initialize the random number generator with arbitrary input, use [member seed] instead. [b]Note:[/b] The default value of this property is pseudo-random, and changes when calling [method randomize]. The [code]0[/code] value documented here is a placeholder, and not the actual default state.
